correctness.rationale: Reconstructed ν^r and ν^s as r/s-point parity progressions and counted their central convolution atom: min(r,s)/(rs)=1/max(r,s). The source supplies central-interval maximality for these symmetric unimodal sums. Mixing four component pairs yields Q2=1/(k+1)+τ_aτ_b/(k(k+1)) in a common cell and min(a,b) for different cells. Variance is v(a)=k(k+1)(1-(2k+1)a/3), continuous strictly decreasing. A common cell gives an exact square gap (τ_a-τ_b)^2/(4k(k+1)); differing cells give a strict inequality from the ordering of cell indices and affine variance matching. Equality iff a=b. Independently checked 2,025 rational parameter pairs, including cell boundaries; that finite test is not the proof.
